# RePaint-NeRF Limitations

Also called: NeRF editing constraints

## Overview
This article documents the limitations of the [RePaint-NeRF](#14365-repaint-nerf.md) framework, which performs [NeRF](#1185-nerf-neural-radiance-fields.md) editing via semantic masks and [diffusion models](#10443-diffusion-models-ddpms.md) [S1]. It addresses the constraints regarding computational efficiency, geometric fidelity during drastic shape changes, and view-angle-dependent artifacts. These limitations distinguish the method from sibling approaches that may prioritize speed or geometric consistency over the specific text-guided semantic editing pipeline [S1].

## Background
RePaint-NeRF was proposed by the authors of the paper "RePaint-NeRF: NeRF Editing via Semantic Masks and Diffusion Models" [S1]. The method utilizes a pre-trained 2D diffusion model to guide the regeneration of masked parts of a NeRF scene, incorporating background prompts and CLIP loss to handle invisible backgrounds, along with depth information for semantic mask acquisition [S1].
